texts: good. the definite moth-count, the peaking event with the count as the thing that peaks, and the seasonal time slot are all carried, so no rewrite is needed. Note only that "early autumn" is stored as one opaque time symbol (early_autumn), so it will not automatically connect to a plain "autumn" used elsewhere in your rules.

mixed: the decline event and the moth-count that undergoes it are both carried, but the "through" is flattened — the parse records only that the decline is located in late autumn, not that it runs across the whole period. If that span sense matters, write "The moth-count declines throughout late autumn." — "throughout" is one of the three words the translator has a dedicated span relation for, whereas "through" has none and falls back to a point-like time slot.
